name: Purple sandpiper
note: The purple sandpipers (B3 wave 3; doc 12 winter, doc 13 'Shaped, not found'): a small, tame winter flock that creeps over the wet rock of a Terrace sea wall the player built in the splash zone, at least home.need.lengthM long (S0 wallsOf, src/world/ecology/shaped.js). The island's own rocky point is unshaped, so it never counts. A seasonal life: it counts toward no tier milestone and gives no gift (the B3 plan: their moment is the reward). BODY: the bird is recipes/birds/<body.birds>.json, made from the turnstone on the same small-bird rig (winter plumage only, so no plumageTurn), drawn at displayScale. ECOLOGY (kind flock, src/world/creatures/flock.js): the turnstones' arc in the hourly tick with the wall as their one 'pool': home is what the live watch last measured (src/app/sandpipers.js records state.creatures.sandpipers.home: met, metres of wall, its middle), so room is one bird per arrival.m2PerOne metres of wall, up to company.n[2]. One flock per island, at the longest wall. A wall gone fails the home: they grow uneasy (why 'wrack', the flock's one reason; their page words it as the wall) and leave after leaveGraceDays. dormancy sandpipers (recipes/world/seasons.json): away north from early spring to mid-autumn; they come later and stay later than the turnstones. visit: the S0 visit until the wall is built; before it, a few birds creep along any shore for an hour. LIFE (src/world/turnstones/live.js, shared with the turnstones): the flock moves along the wall (drift) from one rock spot to the next; spots are the wall's rock standing out of the water, from the wet foot to the top (src/app/sandpipers.js wallSpots). Close by each bird creeps (slowGait, the bird's motion.creep) and picks at the weed (pecks), bobs now and then (bobShare), preens. At night, or with the tide past roostTideM, they roost tucked along the top of the wall, each on its own spot of it (roostOnTop; the bird's motion.roost). flipShare 0: they turn nothing over. A flush is low and tight (small takeoffLagS, seaOutJitter) and lands flushM along the wall. PRESENCE: the walker only (the camera above is never felt). They are famously tame, so the wary ring is small. Trust: watching only (feedTrust 0, no treats, no name), ceiling Curious. knownTrust: their group moment: with you still within joinM, they creep around your boots on the wet rock (around.nearM..farM).

presence._trust: Their trust (F13 section 8): one for the flock, 0..1, saved (state.creatures.sandpipers.trust), only ever grows, earned by quiet watching only. bands: where Tolerant, Curious and Familiar begin; ceiling Curious. knownTrust: the group moment (creature:known), as the turnstones' at 0.5. Tamer than the turnstones: a smaller ring and quicker trust.

feed.none: The sandpipers would rather pick their own food from the wet rock.
